review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join OneAdvanced Our IT Managed Services business enables customers to innovate, transform, and seize new opportunities. The Technical Operations function underpins this mission by delivering enterprise-grade, 24x7x365 technical support to mid-market clients across both public and private sectors. We operate a shared services model aligned with ITIL v4, enabled by ServiceNow, automation, and the practical use of generative and agentic AI. Our 24x7 Operations squads provide proactive management and incident response across infrastructure, cloud and modern workplace services. What You Will Do As a Senior Systems Engineer within our 24x7 Operations function, you will act as the squad's senior technical escalation point on the day shift Squad (Mon-Fri, office hours), taking ownership of complex incidents, major incident response and problem management across both core infrastructure and Microsoft Modern Workplace services. You will combine deep technical capability with sound judgement under pressure, and play an active role in developing the Systems Engineers around you. You will work across multiple customer environments, providing a senior point of reference for Systems Engineers, driving root cause analysis on recurring issues, and contributing to the automation, standards and tooling that underpin the squad's operations. Key Responsibilities Act as third-line escalation point across Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and virtualisation platforms, owning incidents that Systems Engineers are unable to resolve, assisting and guiding them to resolution. Lead or coordinate response to major incidents, including driving stabilisation, coordinating cross-functional input, and providing clear, confident communication to stakeholders under pressure. Own problem management for recurring or systemic issues, using monitoring data, CMDB relationships and log analysis to establish true root cause and prevent recurrence. Design, build and maintain automation and scripting ( e.g. PowerShell, PowerPlatform, Microsoft Graph, AI ) to reduce manual operational load, applying sound engineering practice including version control, error handling, testing and rollback. Review and approve standard and normal changes raised by Systems Engineers, ensuring changes are well-formed, appropriately tested and low-risk before implementation. Support and mentor Systems Engineers, providing technical guidance during shift and contributing to their development. Own the design and continuous improvement of runbooks, knowledge articles and operational standards across the squad. Identify and help implement opportunities to apply generative and agentic AI to reduce manual, repetitive operational work. Participate in shift handovers, providing senior oversight of complex in-flight actions and ensuring continuity across the squad. Partner with Squad Managers on service improvement, workload prioritisation and the technical development of the wider squad. What You Will Have Proven experience operating at third-line within a Microsoft-based infrastructure and workplace services environment. Strong working knowledge of Windows Server administration and Active Directory, including replication, GPO, DNS and DHCP troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services (virtual machines, networking, storage, backup) alongside Microsoft 365. Experience supporting Windows endpoint environments, including Intune and/or Configuration Manager (SCCM), and their supporting infrastructure such as imaging and deployment services. Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating major incident response, with clear communication under pressure. Practical experience using monitoring, event management and CMDB data to drive root cause analysis and problem management. Scripting and automation experience ( e.g. PowerShell, PowerPlatform, Microsoft Graph, AI ), applying sound engineering practices such as version control and testing. Strong understanding of ITIL practices, particularly Incident, Change and Problem Management, including reviewing and approving changes. Experience supporting or mentoring less experienced engineers. Eligibility for UK Government Security Check (SC) clearance. Desirable Skills And Experience Hands-on experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V. Experience with monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor or equivalent, including alert tuning and configuration. Experience applying generative or agentic AI tools to operational workflows, such as automation, knowledge management or ticket triage. Awareness of ISO27001 and operational security controls within live service environments, with experience embedding these into daily practice. Experience working in a shared services or MSP operating model at a senior or escalation level. Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent. What We Value Curious – You seek to understand systems, ask sensible questions and look for better ways of working. Integrity – You follow process, document clearly and act with professionalism at all times. Accountability – You take ownership of your work, your tickets and your development. Connected – You collaborate across shifts and disciplines, supporting team outcomes over individual heroics. Please note, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application. What We Do For You Wellbeing that means something 26 days’ holiday + bank holidays (and the option to buy more) plus 1 paid volunteering day every year Exceptional family leave, 26 weeks fully paid maternity/adoption, 4 weeks fully paid paternity, 22 weeks fully paid shared parental leave, plus 5 days paid bereavement leave Robust sick pay of up to 13 weeks full pay + 13 weeks half pay 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support Private medical insurance for everyone, no medical-history exclusions Financial Benefits That Have Your Back Performance-based rewards tailored to your role, from company-wide bonuses to OTE and commission structures Income protection: up to 75% salary for 5 years if you ever need it Pension with 5% matched company contributions Life assurance worth 4x your salary from day one Free financial planning session with the option to engage in more tailored financial coaching. Grow your career with us SkillsHub learning platform with leadership pathways, future-manager training, and a huge online library Access to external training and apprenticeships Making a Difference MatchIt! Fundraise for a cause close to your heart and OneAdvanced will match part of the funding Pennies from Heaven donate the pennies from your pay check to help make a difference without lifting a finger Plus plenty other flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle on our RewardHub, including: ULEV car scheme with 1,000+ models Dental insurance, Health Cash Plan, Critical Illness Cover, Partner Life Cover, Health Assessment, Gym Membership Who We Are At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society. We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more. OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia. Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation. We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet. Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second-year running , an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference. Learn more at www.oneadvanced.com

Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About The Role As a Desktop Support Engineer II, Executive Technical Support, you will deliver exceptional, high-touch technology support to executive leaders and key stakeholders, ensuring they can operate seamlessly and securely every day. This role combines executive-facing technical support with ownership of workplace technology, including audio/visual solutions and office technology systems. Success in this position requires strong technical expertise, discretion, professionalism, and a commitment to providing an outstanding user experience in a fast-paced environment. Provide flexible coverage across standard and extended business hours, including scheduled on-call rotation and after-hours support as needed. Offer on-site presence for board meetings, all-hands, conferences, and other high-visibility events, including technology setup and standby coverage for the duration. Manage audio/visual setup and troubleshooting for executive presentations and video conferencing. Perform proactive maintenance and monitoring of executive technology systems, including daily equipment checks, meeting preparation, and system health reviews. Maintain and repair executive hardware including computers, printers, mobile devices, and A/V equipment. Image, configure, and deploy new executive devices and manage application rollouts and patching through Jamf and Intune. Collaborate with HR and IT teams to ensure smooth onboarding of new executive staff. Support executive home office setups and provide remote troubleshooting while executives are traveling, including across time zones. Own executive incidents end to end, coordinating escalation with network, security, and application teams until resolution rather than handing off. Follow established ITSM/ITIL processes and maintain accurate documentation of all support activities. Manage and prioritize spare-equipment inventory so executive technology needs are anticipated and met. Strong working knowledge of IT infrastructure including Active Directory, networking, and server technologies. Deep proficiency with Microsoft 365 — Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive — including calendar and mailbox troubleshooting for heavily scheduled executives. Hands-on experience with enterprise ITSM ticketing systems. Working knowledge of VPN, MFA, and remote access tooling, and of the enhanced security policies typically applied to executive accounts and devices. Bonus Skills Proficiency in audio/visual technology setup, troubleshooting, and support for conference rooms and presentation spaces. Experience with installation, cabling, and maintenance of office technology equipment. Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs. Experience supporting executives in a global or multi-site organization. Familiarity with executive travel support, including remote troubleshooting across time zones. Outstanding customer service orientation with polished communication skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a persistent, solution-focused mindset. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills suitable for executive-level interactions. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Government Relations Define, manage, and execute the non-market strategy of Glovo around public affairs, supported by communication and impact and sustainability projects to maximize success and legitimacy. Lead local consultancies and collaborate — where necessary — with think tanks, industry associations and other key agents to plan and execute a robust strategy. Act as a key liaison across various internal departments (Marketing, Legal, Operations, etc.) to ensure cross-departmental alignment on strategies that address the country’s most pressing issues, aligned with business performance and metrics. Work to deliver in-depth analysis to the management team of the local stakeholder environment, risks and opportunities, identifying right relationships in the regulatory, administrative, media and social spheres. You will personally lead engagement with senior stakeholders and high-impact policy discussions, representing Glovo in all instances. Oversee and plan the significant budget allocation, making sure it enables impactful and scalable outputs. PR Comms And Social Media Lead, oversee and execute the planning and execution of external communication strategies, focusing on enhancing brand awareness, improving Glovo’s reputation, and supporting the company's business growth, both in Corporate and Consumer PR. Ensure strategic coherence and consistency in Glovo’s messaging for media relations, while building strong, long-term relationships with journalists, media outlets, and key tech industry KOLs across the region. Create compelling social media content across Instagram and LinkedIn, adventuring into other platforms where Nigerian customers are present. Analyze metrics from PR and social media campaigns to measure effectiveness, providing leadership in data-driven tactical adjustments to achieve better outcomes. Crisis communications management within the region, ensuring swift and professional responses when necessary. Impact & Sustainability Spot the right opportunities to set and implement an ambitious Impact & Sustainability plan that will not only drive positive change but also reduce our negative footprint. Ensure all Impact initiatives support our Global Affairs goals by building key allies and institutional footprint. Draw on global toolkits and data sources to align the I&S strategy with our core business and global I&S plan, working with the regional Africa Impact Lead and local teams to execute good and fast, while proactively finding new avenues for collaboration with local organizations. Qualifications 7-10 years of extensive Government Relations, Public Affairs, or/and PR experience. We’re open to candidates who’ve been leaders in other careers (e.g. legal & corporate affairs, industrial relations, public sector) and may be looking for a career change. Political & Media Mastery: You possess a deep understanding of Nigeria’s highly politicized environment and informal forums to navigate institutional relationships and complex governmental issues. 360° Communication & Impact: You have the creative mindset to manage social media, coordinate influencer-led consumer campaigns, and leverage business milestones to cement Glovo as an industry leader and key socioeconomic contributor. Agile Crisis Management: You are a quick decision-maker capable of handling high-stakes regulatory shifts, media storms, or social media crises under intense pressure and tight deadlines. Strategic "Doer" Mentality: You prioritize doing over delegating, with a startup mindset that empowers you to roll up your sleeves and take direct action to safeguard our business model on a daily basis. On-the-Ground Leadership: Based in Lagos with the flexibility to travel on-demand to our different cities, especially Abuja, you bring native/fluent English alongside exceptional interpersonal abilities for high-stakes engagement. We Believe Driven Talent Deserves 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak. 🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings! 🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home one day a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year! 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being. Additional Information At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here . Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard. Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life? Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

review_candidates.description: 三菱重工グループは、エンジニアリングとものづくりのグローバルリーダーとして、 1884年の創立以来、社会課題に真摯に向き合い、人々の暮らしを支えてきました。 長い歴史の中で培われた高い技術力に最先端の知見を取り入れ、 カーボンニュートラル社会実現に向けたエナジートランジション、社会インフラのスマート化、サイバー・セキュリティ分野の発展に取り組み、人々の豊かな暮らしを実現します。 仕事内容 配属組織の役割・ミッション ◆部◆ 三菱重工業の防衛製品に対する顧客からの期待は、昨今の世界情勢により防衛力の強化が重要視され、国家防衛戦略として防衛装備品の開発・増産ニーズが一層高まっています。その中で、飛昇体製造部は製品に要求される性能を100%発揮する高品質の飛昇体を中心とした防衛製品を効率的に生産していくことで、国民の安全・安心な暮らし、そして我が国の平和に貢献しております。 ◆課◆ 飛昇体（ミサイル）の製造に関する一連のプロジェクトマネジメント業務を担っていただきます。 業務内容 ・飛昇体製品のバリューチェーン全体を俯瞰しつつ、製造プロセスに深く関与するポジション ・製造部門のプロジェクト取り纏めとして、ものづくりをリード 具体的には： 多岐にわたる関係部門(設計、調達、生産技術、現場)と連携し、バリューチェーン全体を企画・管理していく役割を担っていただきます。 期待する役割： ・飛昇体製品のバリューチェーン全体を俯瞰しつつ、製造プロセスに深く関与するポジション ・製造部門のプロジェクト取り纏めとして、ものづくりをリード 使用ツール： 各種オフィスツール、RPA、BIツール 等 入社後は実務を通じて製品・工程理解を深め、担当案件を持ちながらプロジェクトリーダーとして成長していただきます。 数年後には、複数プロジェクトを統括するポジションや、チームマネジメント・組織改革に関わる上位職務への道も広がっています。 研修体制（OJT体制）： 配属後は、数名単位のプロジェクトチームに加わっていただき、OJTを通じて業務を習得いただきます。初期段階では、経験豊富なメンバーによるサポートのもと、段階的に業務範囲を広げていきます。 ポジションのやりがいや魅力 ・自社製品の設計・調達・製造・納入・保守までバリューチェーン全体管理する経験 ・国家プロジェクト(スタンド・オフ・ミサイル 等)に関するプロジェクトの推進 ・裁量を持ってプロジェクトを動かす中で得られる達成感 働き方 リモートワーク：有 出張の有無：有 防衛省、各自衛隊基地、サプライヤー 等 夜勤の有無：無 求める能力・経験・資格 必須要件 製造業で生産管理や生産技術、品質管理について従事経験がある方。 歓迎要件 ・原価管理・コスト管理の経験 ・複数部門に跨るプロジェクト管理経験をお持ちの方(PMP等の資格保有者歓迎) 求める人物像 ・防衛製品に関する作業内容を積極的に学び、真摯に取り組む意欲がある方。 ・協調性があり、誰とでもコミュニケーションがとれる方。 語学力 尚可日米共同開発製品もあり。 学歴 高専卒以上 中途採用事例や他部署からの異動事例 航空運送事業、他業種製造業 等 職種 / 募集ポジション 飛昇体（ミサイル）製造の全体統括／プロジェクト推進 雇用形態 正社員 契約期間 期間の定めなし 給与 年収 想定年収：450万～1200万円 月給制：260,000円～ 通勤手当：あり 住宅手当：あり - 家賃補助制度：最大6万円（名古屋地区は4万5千円） - 寮・社宅完備 家族手当：あり 勤務地 485-8561 愛知県小牧市東田中1200番地 地図で確認 名古屋誘導推進システム製作所 小牧北工場 （変更の範囲）当社の定める場所。将来的に国内外への居住地変更を伴う異動の可能性あり。 勤務時間 8：00～17：00（休憩時間12：00～13：00） ※標準労働時間：1日あたり8時間 フレックスタイム制度あり（コアタイム無し） 休日 ・年間休日126日 ・完全週休2日制（土曜日・日曜日） ・祝日、年末年始、夏季休暇、年次有給休暇（22日）、リフレッシュ休暇、結婚休暇、出産休暇、忌引休暇、ショートバケーション休暇など 福利厚生 財形貯蓄制度、従業員持株会、介護休業・勤務制度、寮・社宅など 加入保険 社会保険（雇用保険、労災保険、健康保険、厚生年金保険） 受動喫煙対策 屋内禁煙 働き方 ・月平均残業時間20～30時間程度（休日出勤を含む） ・在宅勤務：原則として出社（一時的な利用は可能）

What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be. About the role As Oracle Service Delivery Manager, you'll ensure our enterprise Oracle Fusion platform is stable, well governed and improving. Working with our Global Managed Service Provider (MSP), you'll oversee service performance, vendor governance and operational delivery across our Oracle Fusion platform and associated enterprise applications. This is a service governance role rather than a hands-on technical support position. The MSP delivers daily operational support, while you deliver services in line with agreed service levels, contractual commitments and business expectations. We can offer flexible working arrangements for this role: Onsite, Hybrid, or Remote. You will report to the IT Finance Systems Operations Manager. About the environment You'll join a global Enterprise Applications team supporting business-critical finance systems used across multiple countries. You will work with: Global Managed Service Provider responsible for L1-L3 application support Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects Project Delivery teams Finance Global Process Owners Procurement and Commercial teams Enterprise IT Leadership Some information points you may be interested in: 9,000+ Oracle Fusion user base 15+ countries worldwide implemented and growing A support partner that is ISG recognized leader in Oracle Fusion and Manages services Responsibilities Service Operations and Governance: oversee the operational governance of enterprise ERP services delivered through the Managed Service Provider (MSP). You will ensure services remain stable, meet agreed service levels and performance targets, support the successful transition of new releases into production, and are improving. This improvement aims to enhance service quality, reduce recurring incidents, and improve the end-user experience. Vendor & Service Management: act as the primary operational contact for the Managed Service Provider. You will lead service reviews, monitors performance against contractual commitments, and improvement plans where required, and build a collaborative relationship that balances partnership with accountability. Major Incident & Change Management: involves coordinating the response to major ERP incidents. This requires working with technical teams and the MSP to restore service quickly. Additionally, you will perform root cause analysis and improvement actions, while supporting change governance and facilitates the smooth transition of new services into business-as-usual support. Commercial & Performance Management: support the governance of the managed service agreement alongside Procurement and Enterprise IT. This involves monitoring licence usage, identifying commercial and compliance risks, producing regular service reporting, and analysing service trends. Embedded operational governance and change management. Driven measurable improvements in service quality and user experience. review_candidates.description: Location: London / Hybrid with international travel as required Start Date: Subject to contract award About Chemonics UK Chemonics UK delivers transformative programmes that help people live healthier, more productive, and more independent lives. Working with governments, donors, the private sector, and civil society, we tackle some of the world's most complex development, humanitarian, and stabilisation challenges. Please note this is part of an early talent identification exercise linked to a forthcoming opportunity. About The Programme The UK Government's flagship humanitarian programme, HEROS 2.0, will define the UK's ability to respond rapidly and at scale to global humanitarian crises, protracted emergencies, and stabilisation challenges. Chemonics intends to bid for this strategically important programme in the latter half of 2026 and is seeking to engage with exceptional candidates who may be interested in leading its delivery. About The Role Reporting to the Managing Director, Chemonics UK, the HEROS 2.0 Director will provide strategic leadership to a large, complex, and high profile humanitarian programme. Acting as a trusted partner to His Majesty's Government (HMG), the successful candidate will ensure the programme delivers innovative, responsive, and high-quality solutions that strengthen the UK's global humanitarian response capability. The Director will oversee a substantial global portfolio of humanitarian and stabilisation activities, leading multidisciplinary teams and managing strategic relationships across HMG, the Chemonics family of companies, implementing partners, and the wider multilateral humanitarian system. This individual will be the senior point of accountability for programme performance, ensuring delivery against key performance indicators, contractual milestones, and value-for-money commitments while maintaining the highest standards of technical excellence and operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and direction across all programme workstreams. Serve as the senior point of contact for programme performance and client engagement. Lead a geographically dispersed team delivering humanitarian response, logistics, and technical assistance activities. Build and maintain strong relationships with HMG, multilateral agencies, suppliers, and implementing partners. Oversee programme governance, risk management, contractual compliance, and financial performance. Drive innovation and champion technology-enabled solutions that improve humanitarian and stabilisation outcomes. Ensure rapid, effective, and accountable responses to emerging crises and complex operating environments. Foster collaboration across the Chemonics global network to maximise expertise, learning, and impact. Deliver against agreed KPIs, service levels, and contractual milestones. We Are Interested In Hearing From Candidates Who Have Significant leadership experience managing large, complex programmes, ideally for major international donors. A proven track record of setting strategic direction across multiple workstreams while balancing humanitarian, security, and political priorities. Experience engaging and negotiating with senior stakeholders across large organisations and, ideally, government clients. Experience managing portfolios of projects, humanitarian logistics and supply chains, and technical assistance deployments. Extensive experience leading humanitarian or emergency response operations, including field-based delivery. A strong understanding of innovation and the application of technology-enabled solutions within humanitarian and/or stabilisation contexts. Excellent people leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated experience managing large budgets, contractual performance, risk, and value for money. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to remain calm and effective in complex environments. Commercial awareness and the ability to contribute to organisational growth and long-term success. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Desirable Experience Formal programme management qualifications or equivalent expertise. Experience working within HMG or the multilateral humanitarian system. Fluency in an additional official UN language. Register Your Interest This is a scoping opportunity intended to identify and engage with potential candidates ahead of an anticipated bid. If you are an experienced humanitarian leader with a passion for delivering impact at scale and shaping the future of UK-funded crisis response, and you meet the above criteria, we would welcome a confidential conversation. Chemonics is committed to embedding equity, diversity, and inclusion into everything we do. We welcome applications from all sections of society and actively encourage diversity to drive innovation, creativity, success and good practice. We positively welcome and seek to ensure we achieve diversity in our workforce; and that all job applicants and employees receive equal and fair treatment regardless of their background or personal characteristics. Safeguarding At Chemonics, safeguarding – protecting a person’s right to live safely, free from violence, abuse, and neglect – is integral to the work we do. We integrate safeguarding measures to protect our staff, partners, and communities from all forms of violence and apply a survivor-centered approach that is trauma-sensitive, human-rights informed, intersectional, and locally led. All job applicants will complete a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) basic check or equivalent overseas police check will be obtained for Chemonics employees prior to their start date.

review_candidates.title: Conference Producer - Global MedTech & HealthTech
review_candidates.description: About MedTech World Launched in 2020, MedTech World began with a mission to position Malta as a meeting point for the global MedTech and HealthTech ecosystem. Today, we've grown into an international platform operating across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia , bringing together founders, investors, healthcare systems, clinicians, corporates, policymakers and industry leaders. Our global calendar spans flagship summits in Malta, Dubai, West Palm Beach and Hong Kong , alongside investor forums, executive gatherings, roadshows, workshops and curated networking experiences throughout the year. As we continue to expand internationally, we're looking for an ambitious and highly organised Conference Producer to take ownership of the content and programming behind our global events. This isn't simply about filling an agenda. You'll be responsible for identifying the conversations that matter, finding the right people to lead them, and turning those ideas into compelling panels, keynotes, fireside chats and experiences. Working closely with our CEO and wider leadership team, you'll have direct exposure to some of the most exciting companies, investors, healthcare leaders and innovators shaping the future of healthcare. What You'll Do As Conference Producer, you'll take ownership of the programme from the earliest research stage through to execution on-site. You'll: Own the end-to-end conference programme across MedTech World's international events, from initial research and agenda development through speaker confirmation and on-site delivery. Research the latest developments across MedTech, HealthTech, digital health, AI, medical devices, biotechnology, healthcare systems and investment to identify the conversations our audiences need to hear. Develop compelling conference themes, tracks, panel discussions, fireside chats, keynotes and new content formats . Identify and recruit high-calibre speakers including CEOs, founders, investors, clinicians, hospital executives, corporate leaders, academics and policymakers . Lead speaker outreach, invitations and follow-ups, building genuine long-term relationships rather than treating speakers as one-off event participants. Carefully curate panels, ensuring the right balance of expertise, geography, perspectives and personalities on stage. Write strong session titles, descriptions, speaker briefs, moderator notes and agenda copy . Prepare speakers and moderators ahead of each event so conversations are focused, engaging and valuable to the audience. Maintain accurate speaker pipelines, programme schedules, confirmations and deadlines across multiple international events simultaneously. Work closely with our partnerships team to integrate sponsored content while protecting the quality and credibility of the overall programme. Collaborate with our marketing and media teams to identify speakers, sessions and stories that can become interviews, articles, social content and wider campaigns. Work closely with operations and production teams to ensure the programme translates seamlessly from the agenda document to the stage. Be present on-site at our international summits, managing speakers, troubleshooting programme changes and helping ensure every session runs successfully. Where appropriate, moderate panels, conduct interviews or host conversations yourself. Analyse feedback and programme performance after each event and continuously improve our content strategy. Develop new ideas for Investor Forums, CEO gatherings, workshops, roundtables, retreats and other executive formats beyond the traditional conference stage. Build and maintain a strong international network of potential speakers and contributors across the healthcare innovation ecosystem. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who combines curiosity, commercial awareness, editorial judgement and exceptional organisation . You should be comfortable spending the morning researching an emerging healthcare technology, the afternoon speaking with a global CEO or investor, and still making sure dozens of speaker confirmations and programme deadlines are moving forward. Ideally, you'll bring: Previous experience in conference production, agenda development, content production, journalism, research or a similar role . A strong interest in healthcare, technology, entrepreneurship and investment. Excellent research skills and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar or technically complex subjects. Strong editorial judgement — knowing the difference between a topic that sounds interesting and one that will actually create a great conversation on stage. Excellent written and spoken English. Confidence communicating with senior executives, investors, clinicians, government representatives and international stakeholders. Experience with speaker recruitment, outreach and relationship management . Exceptional organisation and attention to detail. The ability to manage large numbers of speakers, deadlines and moving pieces across several international events simultaneously. A proactive mentality — you don't wait to be told which speaker to contact or which topic to research next. The ability to work quickly and calmly when agendas inevitably change. Strong collaboration skills across production, marketing, partnerships, media and operations. Comfort working independently and as part of a distributed international team. Ability and willingness to travel internationally for MedTech World summits and other key events throughout the year. A background in Life Sciences, Medicine, Healthcare, Journalism, Communications, Business or Events is an advantage, but we're much more interested in your ability to research, think, communicate and execute. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means building programmes that people genuinely want to attend. It means securing speakers who elevate the MedTech World brand, identifying important conversations before they become obvious, and creating panels with genuine chemistry rather than simply impressive job titles. It means speakers are confirmed, briefed and prepared well ahead of time — and that when inevitable last-minute changes happen, you're able to find solutions quickly. It also means developing relationships that extend beyond a single event, turning speakers and contributors into long-term members of the MedTech World ecosystem. Ultimately, you'll help shape the voice of MedTech World across four global regions and build the conversations connecting our international community. Why Join MedTech World? Malta-based or remote Our headquarters are in Malta, and we'd love to have you working alongside our team here. However, if you're not based in Malta, this role can also be performed remotely , with regular collaboration across our international team and travel to key MedTech World events. Relocation support If you'd like to relocate to Malta, we'll help make the transition easier, including shared temporary accommodation for your first two months . Build something global You'll help shape conferences across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia , with flagship gatherings in Malta, Dubai, West Palm Beach and Hong Kong. Direct access & responsibility You'll work closely with our CEO and senior leadership, with real ownership over the conversations, speakers and ideas that appear on MedTech World stages. International exposure You'll regularly interact with founders, investors, healthcare executives, multinational companies, clinicians and policymakers from around the world. Travel the world Your role may take you to MedTech World summits, roadshows, investor gatherings and other international events throughout the year. Growth & ownership MedTech World is still growing rapidly. You'll have the opportunity to build new formats, shape our global content strategy, take ownership and grow your responsibilities alongside the organisation. Work & Wander Eligible team members may extend selected business trips across our international hubs, combining remote working with time to explore the destination. T&Cs apply. Flexible hours Start your working day anytime between 07:30 and 09:00 , with flexibility when working across international markets and time zones. Ready to Shape the Conversations Driving the Future of Healthcare? We're looking for someone who gets excited about discovering an exceptional speaker, spotting an emerging trend before everyone else is talking about it, and watching an idea developed months earlier come alive on stage . If you're curious, commercially aware, exceptionally organised and comfortable working across cultures, countries and time zones, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and help us build the next generation of MedTech World.

カーボンニュートラル社会実現に向けたエナジートランジション、社会インフラのスマート化、サイバー・セキュリティ分野の発展に取り組み、人々の豊かな暮らしを実現します。 仕事内容 カーボンニュートラル実現に向けたガスタービンコンバインドサイクル(GTCC)発電プラントの配置配管設計業務 ・GTCCプラントにおけるプラントレイアウト計画、プラント配管計画・設計・手配業務 ・ガスタービン・蒸気タービン廻りの配管、機器等の艤装設計・手配業務 ・図面作成(配管、構造物、ユニット品等) ・各種検討書作成(配管熱応力計算、構造物強度計算等) ・製造現場対応、メーカ対応、お客様対応 募集の背景 世界的な脱炭素社会の実現に向けて、当社では水素ガスタービンの開発を進めると同時に、このガスタービンを用いたGTCC発電プラントの開発と計画に取り組んでいます。 現在、この分野は世界各国で持続的なニーズと新たなビジネス展開が見込まれる中、当社においても脱炭素の中核を担う事業です。脱炭素社会を実現する一員として活躍できる社会貢献度の高い仕事であり、大きな達成感を得られる業務でもあります。 これら社会のニーズに応えるためのエンジニアの確保が急務となっていることから、配置配管設計を行う人材を募集するものです。 仕事の魅力・やりがい 人々の暮らしに欠かせない「発電所」を創り上げること、その社会的意義の大きさはこの仕事の大きな魅力です。 プラント技術部の仕事は、自身が設計し携わったものが目に見える形となり、プラントの稼働を通じて国や地域のインフラ構築に貢献していることを肌で実感できます。そこに大きな達成感があります。 また、大規模プロジェクトを多くの仲間とゴールを共有しながら協力して進めていくため、業務を通じて人との繋がりや一体感を得られることも特徴です。 プラントエンジニア 中堅社員記事：環境と技術の未来を切り拓く。プラントエンジニアが語る、世界で羽ばたく9年間の軌跡 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/55954?utm_source=GTCCLP_pukei&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=recruit プラントエンジニア 幹部記事：グローバルな電力インフラを支える挑戦者──プラント技術部長が描く三菱重工の未来 https://www.talent-book.jp/mhi/stories/55955?utm_source=GTCCLP_pugi&utm_medium=link&utm_campaign=recruit プロジェクトでの求人職種の立ち位置・役割 プロジェクト規模によりますが各関係部門から数名がPJの担当となります。 今回のポジションではプロセス設計の担当として、各設計部門をはじめ、調達、製造、品証、建設等の多岐に渡る部門と協調しながらPJを進めていきます。 キャリアパス・成長の機会 まずは、指導担当とペアを組み、これまでのご経験と親和性のある業務から始めていただくことを想定しています。 OJTや各種技術系教育等を通じて業務の習得度を高めたのち、担当として独り立ちして頂き、ゆくゆくはプロジェクトを最前線でリードして頂きたいと考えています。 国内はもとより、世界各国のお客様やメーカ、海外関連会社との技術調整を通じて、グローバルエンジニアとして成長、活躍するチャンスがあります。 職場の雰囲気 ・上司や同僚との距離が近く、お互いに意見を出し合い、共通の目標に向かって協力する雰囲気のある職場です。 ・キャリア採用社員も多く在籍しており、外国籍社員も在籍しています。 ・子育て中の方もフレックス勤務等で柔軟に働ける環境です。 学歴 高専卒/大学卒/大学院卒（技術系） 求める能力・経験・資格 何事にも前向きに柔軟な発想で取り組むことができる方 チームの一員として周囲と協調する気質をお持ちの方 世界的な脱炭素社会実現と環境負荷低減への貢献を志される方 世の中のエネルギー動向を敏感に捉える好奇心と探求心を持った方 世界各国、または国内のお客様やビジネスパートナーおよび社内関連部署と円滑にコミュニケーションがとれ、粘り強い交渉力と調整力を持った方 （あれば望ましい）求める能力・経験・資格 エンジニアリング経験（機械系、計装制御系、電気系のいずれか） 募集人数 複数名 語学力 特になし new_matches.title: UITVOERDER G/W/E
new_matches.description: DIT GA JE DOEN Als Uitvoerder G/W/E ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse leiding en uitvoering van één of meer projecten op het gebied van gas, water en/of elektra. Je hebt veel eigenaarschap over je functie, maar werkt daarnaast ook nauw samen met je directe collega’s. In deze functie zal jij je onder andere bezighouden met: Begeleiden en coachen van bouwplaats medewerkers; Toezicht houden op inhuurpersoneel; Organiseren en verdelen van arbeid en materiaal; Assisteren bij de voorbereiding van projecten, incl. het maken van de planning; Schakelen met de Werkvoorbereider en Projectleider/Bedrijfsleider; Contact onderhouden met opdrachtgevers, onderaannemers en leveranciers; Bewaken van de technische voortgang, kosten en opbrengsten van het project en zorgen voor een correcte administratieve afhandeling; Controleren op naleving van KAM en veiligheidsregels door alle partijen en actie ondernemen bij afwijkingen. DIT BRENG JE MEE Je hebt een mbo+ diploma in technische richting (Uitvoerder Ondergrondse Infratechniek uitstroomrichting Water/Gas/Energiekabels, Uitvoerder Water/Gas/Energiekabels); Je hebt minimaal twee à drie jaar werkervaring in het uitvoeren van projecten op het gebied van distributieleidingen (gas/water/elektra) ; Je beschikt over relevante diploma’s, zoals KIAD, VIAG, BEI, Veilig Werken Langs de Weg, VCA-VOL en/of BHV, of bent bereid deze diploma’s te halen; Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet je team te motiveren om net dat stapje extra te zetten; Je bent kostenbewust en hebt veiligheid hoog in het vaandel staan. DIT IS MVOI MVOI is een professionele zakenpartner in de infrasector voor de Nederlandse markt. Als onderdeel van de Mourik groep zijn wij een zeer solide bedrijf. Wij zijn gespecialiseerd in de aanleg en aanpassingen van ondergrondse en bovengrondse infrastructuur en geven daarbij deskundig advies. Onze focus ligt met name op de transport- en distributieleidingen op het gebied van gas, water, warmte en elektrotechniek. Werken bij MVOI betekent werken in een stimulerende omgeving met uitdagende projecten. Wij willen een voortrekkersrol vervullen in de energietransitie, door te investeren in innovatieve en milieuvriendelijke oplossingen. Hierbij verliezen wij de kwaliteit en veiligheid niet uit het oog. We geloven in open communicatie, teamwork en het delen van kennis. Daarnaast bieden we kansen voor persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling en streven we naar een positieve en transparante werkcultuur. Als medewerker bij MVOI kun je trots zijn op het feit dat je bijdraagt aan het creëren van een betere wereld. Sluit je bij ons aan en maak deel uit van TeamMVOI! DIT BIEDEN WIJ JOU Elke vier weken een salaris waar je blij van wordt; Veel vakantie-/ADV-dagen en 8% vakantiegeld om volop van te genieten; Auto van de zaak, laptop en mobiele telefoon om je werk tot in de puntjes te kunnen uitvoeren; Goede pensioenregeling om je toekomst te verzekeren; Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen (o.a. via de Mourik Academy); De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan onze fiets- of bedrijfsfitnessregelingen en/of collectieve zorgverzekering, zodat je fit en gezond kunt blijven; Uitdagende werkomgeving met een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Plezierig team met ruime ervaring, waarin je kunt samenwerken en van elkaar kunt leren. SOLLICITEREN Heeft deze vacature jouw interesse gewekt? Solliciteer dan via de onderstaande sollicitatieknop of stuur je cv met motivatie naar werken@mvoi.nl . Voor vragen kan je contact opnemen met Simon Visser via 06-26356712 of werken@mvoi.nl . Solliciteer direct Solliciteren

new_matches.title: UI/UX designér do redakce iDNES.cz
new_matches.description: Hledáme parťáka do malého týmu — zkušeného webdesignera, který má přesah do přípravy vizuálů pro reklamní kampaně a marketing. Pracovat budeš na největším českém zpravodajském webu, který si denně otevřou miliony lidí. Co Budeš Dělat rozvoj produktu — návrh a prototypování nových podstránek a příloh, vylepšování designu a flow u stávajících částí, prvků a komponent, skládání a úprava stránek z prvků design systému, export použitých prvků pro vývojáře, denní grafika — selfpromo bannery, obrázky pro web a sociální sítě, marketingové vizuály a printová grafika — inzerce, plakáty, billboardy a další formáty, microsites pro externí klienty, dotahování rozpracovaného webdesignu (doplnění reálných textů a fotografií), podpora redakce při tvorbě interaktivních grafů a infografik (infogram.com), rešerše fotografií, ikon a ilustrací z fotobank, ilustrace ikon a další vektorové grafiky, retuš fotografií. Co Musíš Umět figmu na pokročilé úrovni — auto layout, variables, code syntax, komponenty, Adobe CC — Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, prototypování, připravit marketingové vizuály online i offline — bannery, billboardy, inzertní formáty, mít cit pro grafiku a základní přehled v typografii, mít silné portfolio — bez něj se vážně neobejdeme. Jak přemýšlíš a pracuješ — na tom nám záleží nejvíc: rychle se zorientuješ v design systému a osvojíš si ho, myslíš v kontextu a několik kroků dopředu, nerozhodí tě nekompletní zadání — umíš se sám doptat na chybějící specifikace, máš silnou intuici, ale co nevíš, si zjistíš nebo si uděláš průzkum, řešení nestavíš na tom, aby byla jen hezká, ale hlavně srozumitelná pro uživatele, svá rozhodnutí umíš vysvětlit a obhájit, věci dotahuješ do konce a přicházíš s vlastními nápady i s dotazy, pracuješ efektivně a neztrácíš čas laděním detailů, kterých si stejně skoro nikdo nevšimne, máš přesah do UX researche a discovery. Výhodou, Ne Však Podmínkou webové animace, digitální ilustrace, povědomí o HTML a CSS, využívat AI nástroje k zefektivnění práce, práce na Macu. Co Nabízíme práci v malém, sehraném týmu, který ti vyjde vstříc, práci v největší mediální skupině na trhu — tvoje práce se dostane ke statisícům čtenářů denně, možnost čerpat zkušenosti z oblasti grafiky, typografie, webdesignu a AI od zkušeného kolegy. Spolu s CV nezapomeň poslat i portfolio nebo odkaz na něj. Moc se na tvoji reakci těšíme! new_matches.title: Senior Project Manager
new_matches.description: Job Title: Senior Project Manager Location: Remote – OR, WA or TX Work type: Field The salary range for this position is dependent upon experience, ranging from $128,320 to $160,400. Job Summary The Project Manager will manage engineering and construction activities during the pre-construction and construction phases of new projects and during modifications to existing projects for Avangrid Renewables. The Project Manager will provide recommendations on costs, schedules and other factors for construction and operations of proposed or existing energy facilities. He or she will also manage project activities, including budgeted cost and schedule, during the engineering, procurement, and construction phases of Company's projects. Responsibilities Responsible for developing design, procurement and construction contracts during project pre-construction phases. Directs project engineers and construction site managers to ensure that project milestones are met safely, on schedule, and within budget. Responsible for negotiation and management of engineering, procurement, and construction ("EPC") activities. Responsible for owner's project management during project implementation phases on multiple wind and thermal energy projects. Leads a team of professionals who provide technical expertise and project support through design, construction, commissioning and operations. Provides periodic updates to company senior management group on project activities, progress and issues. Develop a safety awareness culture, emphasized at the personal workplace, within project designs and throughout construction and operation. Assists with technical due diligence in conjunction with other departments. Responsible for effective forecasting of Company's capital budget spending on assigned projects. Responsible for providing support to plant operations, including plant and process improvements, equipment acquisition, plant breakdown analysis, and recommending corrective actions. Ensures process feedback mechanisms are implemented and utilized for identifying process efficiencies and improvements, including process and functional quality audits, and focusing on Company strategic initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management or related study plus 10 years’ experience in project engineering and construction of electric generation projects. 5 years’ experience in project development or management. Demonstrated oral and written communication, effective negotiating and dispute resolution skills. Proficiency using personal computer tools such as Word, Excel, Primavera P3, and Thermo-flow GT Pro/GT Master. Ability to travel 20% Preferred Qualifications A working knowledge of construction law, contracts, claims avoidance, insurance, and contract administration. Behavioral Competencies Develop self & others Empower to grow Collaborate and share Be a role model Focus to achieve results Be agile Company AVANGRID POWER, LLC Mobility Information Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. At Avangrid we provide fair and equal employment and advancement opportunities for all employees and candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who is unable to use our online tool to search for or to apply for jobs, you may request a reasonable accommodation by contacting our People and Organization department at careers@avangrid.com. Avangrid employees may be assigned a system emergency role and in the event of a system emergency, may be required to work outside of their regular schedule/job duties. Avangrid employees may also be assigned a NERC Reliability Standards compliance role supporting Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) and/or Operations and Planning (O&P) responsibilities. new_matches.title: Senior Portfolio Director, Health Innovation South West
new_matches.description: Health Innovation South West is at an exciting point in its development. Serving a region defined by its rural geography and extensive coastline, it works at the intersection of health, care and economic development, tackling some of the most complex challenges facing communities across Somerset, Devon and Cornwall. Through innovation, partnership and evidence-led improvement, it seeks to improve health and care services, health outcomes and economic growth. Licensed and commissioned by NHS England and the Office for Life Sciences, and working as part of the national Health Innovation Network, the organisation has established a strong track record in finding, testing and scaling innovation that delivers meaningful impact for people and places across the South West Peninsula. We are now seeking an exceptional Senior Portfolio Director to join the Senior Management Team. This is a significant leadership role, responsible for translating strategic ambitions into high-impact portfolios of work that address regional priorities and system-wide challenges. Leading the design, development and delivery of complex, multi-partner programmes, the postholder will bring together colleagues from across the NHS, local government, academia, industry and national bodies to co-design, fund and implement transformative innovation initiatives. Working closely with the Commercial Director, they will build a strong business development pipeline, secure investment and funding opportunities, oversee a portfolio budget of £2m to £3m, and ensure that programmes deliver measurable outcomes for commissioners, customers and communities. The successful candidate will bring substantial experience of leading innovation, improvement or transformational change within health and care, academia and/or industry. They will have a proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale, cross-system portfolios in complex environments, coupled with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build enduring partnerships across multiple sectors. Commercially astute and financially confident, they will demonstrate success in generating income, securing investment and managing diverse programmes of work. An accomplished and collaborative leader, they will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, motivating high-performing teams and communicating with clarity and influence. Above all, they will share a commitment to improving lives through innovation and to addressing the distinctive challenges and opportunities of rural and coastal communities. Saxton Bampfylde Ltd is acting as an employment agency advisor to Health Innovation South West on this appointment. For further information about the role, including details about how to apply, please visit roles.saxbam.com using reference ABXNC. Alternatively email belinda.beck@saxbam.com. Applications should be received by noon on Friday 11 September 2026.

You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact As a Senior Delivery Manager, you will lead the end-to-end implementation of large-scale transformation programs, working closely with senior client executives to translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and deliver measurable, sustainable impact. You will oversee complex transformation portfolios, coordinating multiple workstreams and guiding teams through structured problem solving, stakeholder engagement, and hands-on implementation to achieve program objectives. In this role, you will ensure successful program delivery by establishing strong governance structures, monitoring overall transformation progress, anticipating risks, and driving timely corrective actions to maintain momentum and deliver results. You’ll translate strategic priorities into comprehensive implementation roadmaps and operational initiatives, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and functions while maintaining a clear focus on value delivery. You will guide teams in identifying information sources, conducting analyses, and synthesizing insights to inform decision making, while ensuring that progress and outcomes are clearly communicated to senior client stakeholders. You’ll mentor and develop consultants and delivery managers, supporting them in solving complex implementation challenges and fostering a collaborative, high-performance team environment. You will also play a key role in strengthening the firm’s implementation capabilities by codifying lessons learned from transformation programs, contributing to knowledge development, and supporting the growth of delivery teams. In addition, you will shape your own development by working closely with senior partners and leaders on high-impact transformation programs across sectors such as financial institutions, public sector, and operations-driven environments. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Government Relations Define, manage, and execute the non-market strategy of Glovo around public affairs, supported by communication and impact and sustainability projects to maximize success and legitimacy. Lead local consultancies and collaborate — where necessary — with think tanks, industry associations and other key agents to plan and execute a robust strategy. Act as a key liaison across various internal departments (Marketing, Legal, Operations, etc.) to ensure cross-departmental alignment on strategies that address the country’s most pressing issues, aligned with business performance and metrics. Work to deliver in-depth analysis to the management team of the local stakeholder environment, risks and opportunities, identifying right relationships in the regulatory, administrative, media and social spheres. You will personally lead engagement with senior stakeholders and high-impact policy discussions, representing Glovo in all instances. Oversee and plan the significant budget allocation, making sure it enables impactful and scalable outputs. PR Comms And Social Media Lead, oversee and execute the planning and execution of external communication strategies, focusing on enhancing brand awareness, improving Glovo’s reputation, and supporting the company's business growth, both in Corporate and Consumer PR. Ensure strategic coherence and consistency in Glovo’s messaging for media relations, while building strong, long-term relationships with journalists, media outlets, and key tech industry KOLs across the region. Create compelling social media content across Instagram and LinkedIn, adventuring into other platforms where Nigerian customers are present. Analyze metrics from PR and social media campaigns to measure effectiveness, providing leadership in data-driven tactical adjustments to achieve better outcomes. Crisis communications management within the region, ensuring swift and professional responses when necessary. Impact & Sustainability Spot the right opportunities to set and implement an ambitious Impact & Sustainability plan that will not only drive positive change but also reduce our negative footprint. Ensure all Impact initiatives support our Global Affairs goals by building key allies and institutional footprint. Draw on global toolkits and data sources to align the I&S strategy with our core business and global I&S plan, working with the regional Africa Impact Lead and local teams to execute good and fast, while proactively finding new avenues for collaboration with local organizations. Qualifications 7-10 years of extensive Government Relations, Public Affairs, or/and PR experience. We’re open to candidates who’ve been leaders in other careers (e.g. legal & corporate affairs, industrial relations, public sector) and may be looking for a career change. Political & Media Mastery: You possess a deep understanding of Nigeria’s highly politicized environment and informal forums to navigate institutional relationships and complex governmental issues. 360° Communication & Impact: You have the creative mindset to manage social media, coordinate influencer-led consumer campaigns, and leverage business milestones to cement Glovo as an industry leader and key socioeconomic contributor. Agile Crisis Management: You are a quick decision-maker capable of handling high-stakes regulatory shifts, media storms, or social media crises under intense pressure and tight deadlines. Strategic "Doer" Mentality: You prioritize doing over delegating, with a startup mindset that empowers you to roll up your sleeves and take direct action to safeguard our business model on a daily basis. On-the-Ground Leadership: Based in Lagos with the flexibility to travel on-demand to our different cities, especially Abuja, you bring native/fluent English alongside exceptional interpersonal abilities for high-stakes engagement. We Believe Driven Talent Deserves 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak. 🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings! 🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home one day a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year! 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being. Additional Information At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here . Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard. Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life? Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

new_matches.description: 三菱重工グループは、エンジニアリングとものづくりのグローバルリーダーとして、 1884年の創立以来、社会課題に真摯に向き合い、人々の暮らしを支えてきました。 長い歴史の中で培われた高い技術力に最先端の知見を取り入れ、 カーボンニュートラル社会実現に向けたエナジートランジション、社会インフラのスマート化、サイバー・セキュリティ分野の発展に取り組み、人々の豊かな暮らしを実現します。 仕事内容 配属組織の役割・ミッション ◆部◆ 三菱重工業の防衛製品に対する顧客からの期待は、昨今の世界情勢により防衛力の強化が重要視され、国家防衛戦略として防衛装備品の開発・増産ニーズが一層高まっています。その中で、飛昇体製造部は製品に要求される性能を100%発揮する高品質の飛昇体を中心とした防衛製品を効率的に生産していくことで、国民の安全・安心な暮らし、そして我が国の平和に貢献しております。 ◆課◆ 飛昇体（ミサイル）の製造に関する一連のプロジェクトマネジメント業務を担っていただきます。 業務内容 ・飛昇体製品のバリューチェーン全体を俯瞰しつつ、製造プロセスに深く関与するポジション ・製造部門のプロジェクト取り纏めとして、ものづくりをリード 具体的には： 多岐にわたる関係部門(設計、調達、生産技術、現場)と連携し、バリューチェーン全体を企画・管理していく役割を担っていただきます。 期待する役割： ・飛昇体製品のバリューチェーン全体を俯瞰しつつ、製造プロセスに深く関与するポジション ・製造部門のプロジェクト取り纏めとして、ものづくりをリード 使用ツール： 各種オフィスツール、RPA、BIツール 等 入社後は実務を通じて製品・工程理解を深め、担当案件を持ちながらプロジェクトリーダーとして成長していただきます。 数年後には、複数プロジェクトを統括するポジションや、チームマネジメント・組織改革に関わる上位職務への道も広がっています。 研修体制（OJT体制）： 配属後は、数名単位のプロジェクトチームに加わっていただき、OJTを通じて業務を習得いただきます。初期段階では、経験豊富なメンバーによるサポートのもと、段階的に業務範囲を広げていきます。 ポジションのやりがいや魅力 ・自社製品の設計・調達・製造・納入・保守までバリューチェーン全体管理する経験 ・国家プロジェクト(スタンド・オフ・ミサイル 等)に関するプロジェクトの推進 ・裁量を持ってプロジェクトを動かす中で得られる達成感 働き方 リモートワーク：有 出張の有無：有 防衛省、各自衛隊基地、サプライヤー 等 夜勤の有無：無 求める能力・経験・資格 必須要件 製造業で生産管理や生産技術、品質管理について従事経験がある方。 歓迎要件 ・原価管理・コスト管理の経験 ・複数部門に跨るプロジェクト管理経験をお持ちの方(PMP等の資格保有者歓迎) 求める人物像 ・防衛製品に関する作業内容を積極的に学び、真摯に取り組む意欲がある方。 ・協調性があり、誰とでもコミュニケーションがとれる方。 語学力 尚可日米共同開発製品もあり。 学歴 高専卒以上 中途採用事例や他部署からの異動事例 航空運送事業、他業種製造業 等 職種 / 募集ポジション 飛昇体（ミサイル）製造の全体統括／プロジェクト推進 雇用形態 正社員 契約期間 期間の定めなし 給与 年収 想定年収：450万～1200万円 月給制：260,000円～ 通勤手当：あり 住宅手当：あり - 家賃補助制度：最大6万円（名古屋地区は4万5千円） - 寮・社宅完備 家族手当：あり 勤務地 485-8561 愛知県小牧市東田中1200番地 地図で確認 名古屋誘導推進システム製作所 小牧北工場 （変更の範囲）当社の定める場所。将来的に国内外への居住地変更を伴う異動の可能性あり。 勤務時間 8：00～17：00（休憩時間12：00～13：00） ※標準労働時間：1日あたり8時間 フレックスタイム制度あり（コアタイム無し） 休日 ・年間休日126日 ・完全週休2日制（土曜日・日曜日） ・祝日、年末年始、夏季休暇、年次有給休暇（22日）、リフレッシュ休暇、結婚休暇、出産休暇、忌引休暇、ショートバケーション休暇など 福利厚生 財形貯蓄制度、従業員持株会、介護休業・勤務制度、寮・社宅など 加入保険 社会保険（雇用保険、労災保険、健康保険、厚生年金保険） 受動喫煙対策 屋内禁煙 働き方 ・月平均残業時間20～30時間程度（休日出勤を含む） ・在宅勤務：原則として出社（一時的な利用は可能）

new_matches.title: Service Delivery Manager - Oracle Fusion
new_matches.description: About Inizio At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health. Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI to create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey - from discovery to post-launch. Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients. What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be. About the role As Oracle Service Delivery Manager, you'll ensure our enterprise Oracle Fusion platform is stable, well governed and improving. Working with our Global Managed Service Provider (MSP), you'll oversee service performance, vendor governance and operational delivery across our Oracle Fusion platform and associated enterprise applications. This is a service governance role rather than a hands-on technical support position. The MSP delivers daily operational support, while you deliver services in line with agreed service levels, contractual commitments and business expectations. We can offer flexible working arrangements for this role: Onsite, Hybrid, or Remote. You will report to the IT Finance Systems Operations Manager. About the environment You'll join a global Enterprise Applications team supporting business-critical finance systems used across multiple countries. You will work with: Global Managed Service Provider responsible for L1-L3 application support Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects Project Delivery teams Finance Global Process Owners Procurement and Commercial teams Enterprise IT Leadership Some information points you may be interested in: 9,000+ Oracle Fusion user base 15+ countries worldwide implemented and growing A support partner that is ISG recognized leader in Oracle Fusion and Manages services Responsibilities Service Operations and Governance: oversee the operational governance of enterprise ERP services delivered through the Managed Service Provider (MSP). You will ensure services remain stable, meet agreed service levels and performance targets, support the successful transition of new releases into production, and are improving. This improvement aims to enhance service quality, reduce recurring incidents, and improve the end-user experience. Vendor & Service Management: act as the primary operational contact for the Managed Service Provider. You will lead service reviews, monitors performance against contractual commitments, and improvement plans where required, and build a collaborative relationship that balances partnership with accountability. Major Incident & Change Management: involves coordinating the response to major ERP incidents. This requires working with technical teams and the MSP to restore service quickly. Additionally, you will perform root cause analysis and improvement actions, while supporting change governance and facilitates the smooth transition of new services into business-as-usual support. Commercial & Performance Management: support the governance of the managed service agreement alongside Procurement and Enterprise IT. This involves monitoring licence usage, identifying commercial and compliance risks, producing regular service reporting, and analysing service trends. The goal is to improve and maximise service value. Stakeholder Management: build relationships across Finance, Enterprise IT, and Business teams. You will achieve this by communicating service performance, risks, and planned changes in a clear and meaningful way. Additionally, it provides senior leaders with accurate operational insight to support informed decision-making. What success looks like Within your first 12 months you will have: Established a working relationship with our Managed Service Provider. Improved visibility of ERP service performance through meaningful reporting. Maintained stable service performance against agreed Service level agreements. Embedded operational governance and change management. Driven measurable improvements in service quality and user experience. About you We're looking for someone with service management experience who enjoys building relationships, holding suppliers to account across business-critical systems. You'll bring: Experience managing and governing enterprise application services delivered through a Global Managed Service Provider (MSP). An understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL Foundation or equivalent experience preferred). Experience working with enterprise ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, SAP, Workday or similar. Vendor management skills, with experience monitoring service performance. Experience coordinating major incidents and working across technical and business teams to restore service. Experience working in a global, complex organisation. Our Pledge At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications. Applications are accepted regardless of race, color, religion, or belief. They are also accepted regardless of gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disability. Artificial Intelligence Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions at Inizio are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

This can involve simulating elements of the product to allow testing of all scenarios, to using image recognition or advanced technologies for automatic identification of elements displayed on the user interface. Quality is ensured and actively maintained during the Scaled Agile Framework development process by our QMS experts, and accepting customer correspondence to improve future products. Our labs allow unattended testing of partial to full products including moving robots, allowing the team to work remotely. About The Role Own and define the quality and verification strategy across embedded software, app, IoT, and cloud platforms. Build and develop high-performing Test & QA teams, coach Test&QA Leads and Managers. Provide technical direction for system, integration, protocol, connectivity, security, and compliance testing. And Test architecture, automation test strategy for complex multi-platform systems. Drive innovation in HIL automation, simulation, data-driven testing, and AI-enabled test methods. Represent Test & QA in program governance, influencing release decisions with strong quality evidence. Oversee quality metrics, dashboards, and analytics for defect trends, maturity, and reliability insights. Ensure compliance with industry standards: security, RF, Matter, safety, Market regulations. Stay updated on the latest automation testing strategies, techniques, tools, and frameworks. Collaborate with project managers, design managers and architects to test plan & strategy and budget. Report projects test progress & software quality status to senior stakeholders and ensure clear communication across teams. About you Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics, Software Engineering, or similar. 15+ years in software/embedded/IoT/app/cloud testing, including 7+ years Test & QA teams Manager. Proven experience managing electronic hardware and software quality for large-scale, multi-platform consumer products. Strong technical depth in automation (Python/C/Kotlin/Swift), CI/CD pipelines, protocol testing (BLE/Wi-Fi/MQTT), embedded testing, API testing, and mobile test frameworks. Skilled in using test tools such as protocol analyzers, device sniffers, Simulators, mobile app and cloud test utilities. Data-driven mindset with experience in dashboards, observability, and quality analytics. Passionate about quality, continuous improvement, and raising engineering standards. Excellent leadership and cross-functional influencing skills. Ability to mentor teams, uplift competencies, and build a high-performance engineering culture. Strong systems thinking across embedded, electrical, mechanical, cloud, and app ecosystems. Experience with the full electronic hardware and software development and test lifecycle and Agile development & test processes. Ability to shape long-term testing capability and lead transformation in automation and test methods. Expertise in automated testing, requirements analysis, test framework design, development, and debugging for both embedded software and IoT systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical information clearly to executives and non-technical leaders. Strong ability to multi-task across multiple product deliverables and manage multiple schedules simultaneously. Benefits Dyson monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. But financial benefits are just the start of a Dyson career. Professional growth, leadership development and new opportunities abound, driven by regular reviews and dynamic workshops. And with a vibrant culture, the latest devices and a relaxed dress code reflecting our engineering spirit, it’s an exciting team environment geared to fuelling and realising ambition.
