Our global calendar spans flagship summits in Malta, Dubai, West Palm Beach and Hong Kong , alongside investor forums, executive gatherings, roadshows, workshops and curated networking experiences throughout the year. As we continue to expand internationally, we're looking for an ambitious and highly organised Conference Producer to take ownership of the content and programming behind our global events. This isn't simply about filling an agenda. You'll be responsible for identifying the conversations that matter, finding the right people to lead them, and turning those ideas into compelling panels, keynotes, fireside chats and experiences. Working closely with our CEO and wider leadership team, you'll have direct exposure to some of the most exciting companies, investors, healthcare leaders and innovators shaping the future of healthcare. What You'll Do As Conference Producer, you'll take ownership of the programme from the earliest research stage through to execution on-site. You'll: Own the end-to-end conference programme across MedTech World's international events, from initial research and agenda development through speaker confirmation and on-site delivery. Research the latest developments across MedTech, HealthTech, digital health, AI, medical devices, biotechnology, healthcare systems and investment to identify the conversations our audiences need to hear. Develop compelling conference themes, tracks, panel discussions, fireside chats, keynotes and new content formats . Identify and recruit high-calibre speakers including CEOs, founders, investors, clinicians, hospital executives, corporate leaders, academics and policymakers . Lead speaker outreach, invitations and follow-ups, building genuine long-term relationships rather than treating speakers as one-off event participants. Carefully curate panels, ensuring the right balance of expertise, geography, perspectives and personalities on stage. Write strong session titles, descriptions, speaker briefs, moderator notes and agenda copy . Prepare speakers and moderators ahead of each event so conversations are focused, engaging and valuable to the audience. Maintain accurate speaker pipelines, programme schedules, confirmations and deadlines across multiple international events simultaneously. Work closely with our partnerships team to integrate sponsored content while protecting the quality and credibility of the overall programme. Collaborate with our marketing and media teams to identify speakers, sessions and stories that can become interviews, articles, social content and wider campaigns. Work closely with operations and production teams to ensure the programme translates seamlessly from the agenda document to the stage. Be present on-site at our international summits, managing speakers, troubleshooting programme changes and helping ensure every session runs successfully. Where appropriate, moderate panels, conduct interviews or host conversations yourself. Analyse feedback and programme performance after each event and continuously improve our content strategy. Develop new ideas for Investor Forums, CEO gatherings, workshops, roundtables, retreats and other executive formats beyond the traditional conference stage. Build and maintain a strong international network of potential speakers and contributors across the healthcare innovation ecosystem. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who combines curiosity, commercial awareness, editorial judgement and exceptional organisation . You should be comfortable spending the morning researching an emerging healthcare technology, the afternoon speaking with a global CEO or investor, and still making sure dozens of speaker confirmations and programme deadlines are moving forward. Ideally, you'll bring: Previous experience in conference production, agenda development, content production, journalism, research or a similar role . A strong interest in healthcare, technology, entrepreneurship and investment. Excellent research skills and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar or technically complex subjects. Strong editorial judgement — knowing the difference between a topic that sounds interesting and one that will actually create a great conversation on stage. Excellent written and spoken English. Confidence communicating with senior executives, investors, clinicians, government representatives and international stakeholders. Experience with speaker recruitment, outreach and relationship management . Exceptional organisation and attention to detail. The ability to manage large numbers of speakers, deadlines and moving pieces across several international events simultaneously. A proactive mentality — you don't wait to be told which speaker to contact or which topic to research next. The ability to work quickly and calmly when agendas inevitably change. Strong collaboration skills across production, marketing, partnerships, media and operations. Comfort working independently and as part of a distributed international team. Ability and willingness to travel internationally for MedTech World summits and other key events throughout the year. A background in Life Sciences, Medicine, Healthcare, Journalism, Communications, Business or Events is an advantage, but we're much more interested in your ability to research, think, communicate and execute. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means building programmes that people genuinely want to attend. It means securing speakers who elevate the MedTech World brand, identifying important conversations before they become obvious, and creating panels with genuine chemistry rather than simply impressive job titles. It means speakers are confirmed, briefed and prepared well ahead of time — and that when inevitable last-minute changes happen, you're able to find solutions quickly. It also means developing relationships that extend beyond a single event, turning speakers and contributors into long-term members of the MedTech World ecosystem. Ultimately, you'll help shape the voice of MedTech World across four global regions and build the conversations connecting our international community. Why Join MedTech World? Malta-based or remote Our headquarters are in Malta, and we'd love to have you working alongside our team here. However, if you're not based in Malta, this role can also be performed remotely , with regular collaboration across our international team and travel to key MedTech World events. Relocation support If you'd like to relocate to Malta, we'll help make the transition easier, including shared temporary accommodation for your first two months . Build something global You'll help shape conferences across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia , with flagship gatherings in Malta, Dubai, West Palm Beach and Hong Kong. Direct access & responsibility You'll work closely with our CEO and senior leadership, with real ownership over the conversations, speakers and ideas that appear on MedTech World stages. International exposure You'll regularly interact with founders, investors, healthcare executives, multinational companies, clinicians and policymakers from around the world. Travel the world Your role may take you to MedTech World summits, roadshows, investor gatherings and other international events throughout the year. Growth & ownership MedTech World is still growing rapidly. You'll have the opportunity to build new formats, shape our global content strategy, take ownership and grow your responsibilities alongside the organisation. Work & Wander Eligible team members may extend selected business trips across our international hubs, combining remote working with time to explore the destination. T&Cs apply. Ready to Shape the Conversations Driving the Future of Healthcare? We're looking for someone who gets excited about discovering an exceptional speaker, spotting an emerging trend before everyone else is talking about it, and watching an idea developed months earlier come alive on stage . If you're curious, commercially aware, exceptionally organised and comfortable working across cultures, countries and time zones, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and help us build the next generation of MedTech World.

new_matches.title: Chef de projet Transformation F/H
new_matches.description: L'Établissement Français du Sang engage une transformation d'ampleur de son organisation et de ses processus, portée notamment par le programme Ambition Plasma, premier programme de transformation de l'établissement, ainsi que par plusieurs chantiers de modernisation et de mutualisation de fonctions support (Achats, Juridique, RH, Finances). La mission Innovation et Transformation (MIT), est garante de la cohérence, du pilotage et de la méthodologie de cette dynamique de transformation. Elle anime les instances de gouvernance dédiées et accompagne les directions métiers et les porteurs de programme dans la structuration et la mise en œuvre de leurs projets. Dans ce cadre, la MIT recrute un chef de projet, qui interviendra à parité sur deux volets complémentaires : un rôle d'appui transversal au pilotage stratégique d'une part, et la conduite opérationnelle de chantiers de transformation et de modernisation d'autre part. Missions générales : 🩸 Piloter le portefeuille de projets et le plan de transformation, en appui à la directrice de la MIT et à la gouvernance de l’EFS : Consolider et mettre à jour la vision d’ensemble du portefeuille de projets (avancement, risques, jalons, ressources) Contribuer à la préparation des réunions du Comité d’engagement des projets et du COPIL Transformation : concevoir des présentations et documents de synthèse pour différentes instances, suivre les décisions et les actions, remonter les alertes, formaliser les demandes d’arbitrage 🩸 Outiller et fiabiliser le pilotage du portefeuille : Contribuer à la définition et à l’amélioration continue des outils, gabarits et rituels de pilotage de projet (reporting, tableaux de bord, méthodologie) Détecter les risques transverses au portefeuille et proposer des plans d’atténuation Produire des analyses et notes de synthèse destinées à la direction générale 🩸 Piloter en propre des chantiers de transformation et de modernisation identifiés comme prioritaires, du cadrage jusqu’à la mise en œuvre : Cadrer les chantiers confiés : objectifs, planning, budget et livrables, et analyse des risques, en lien avec les sponsors et parties prenantes métiers et piloter l’avancement du projet Coordonner les contributeurs internes mobilisés sur les chantiers et les prestataires externes Produire les éléments d’aide à la décision 🩸Organiser et suivre l’accompagnement au changement, avec les directions concernées : Co-construire les plans d’accompagnement selon les cibles et impacts identifiés Préparer les équipes internes à l’évolution des pratiques Faciliter l’appropriation des nouveaux outils et des nouveaux processus Assurer une communication tout au long des chantiers Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation et transformation ou en gestion de projet/PMO, acquise dans un environnement complexe. Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies de gestion de projet, les outils de pilotage et savez produire des supports d'aide à la décision clairs et synthétiques. Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome, vous faites preuve d'une forte capacité d'adaptation et êtes en mesure de piloter plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous disposez d'une bonne connaissance de la conduite du changement et maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel et PowerPoint ; la connaissance d'un outil de gestion de portefeuille de projets est un plus. Reconnu(e) pour vos qualités relationnelles, votre sens de l'analyse et de la synthèse, vous savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux. Discrétion, sens du service et pédagogie complètent votre profil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Um breve resumo de como será o seu dia dia: Realizar o agendamento de procedimentos cirúrgicos via sistema, conferindo a disponibilidade de salas, equipamentos e equipes para garantir a montagem correta do mapa cirúrgico; Apoiar a realização do "Bate-Mapa" (reunião de planejamento), fornecendo dados precisos sobre as necessidades de materiais e OPMEs para a equipe multiprofissional; Monitorar os indicadores básicos de produtividade (cancelamentos e atrasos), reportando as justificativas e falhas no agendamento para análise da Supervisão; Comunicar prontamente qualquer alteração de agenda às equipes assistenciais e de apoio, utilizando os canais institucionais para garantir a fluidez do fluxo cirúrgico; Atender às demandas telefônicas e presenciais do corpo clínico e consultórios, solucionando dúvidas sobre horários e procedimentos com agilidade e cordialidade; Fornecer documentos e relatórios para auditorias internas e externas, organizando os arquivos do setor para garantir a conformidade com as normas institucionais; Realizar o agendamento de procedimentos cirúrgicos via sistema, conferindo a disponibilidade de salas, equipamentos e equipes para garantir a montagem correta do mapa cirúrgico; Conferir a documentação pré-operatória (autorizações, laudos e exames), verificando as pendências com antecedência para evitar cancelamentos no dia da cirurgia. Requisitos e qualificações O que você precisa ter: Ensino médio completo; Noções intermediárias do Pacote Office; Desejável conhecimento em rotinas administrativas hospitalares; Disponibilidade para atuar de segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h, e aos sábados, das 07h às 11h. Informações adicionais Valorizamos nossos colaboradores que são a força motriz da instituição. Atuamos no bem-estar, ofertando benefícios e promovendo condições plenas de atuação. Confira alguns dos benefícios disponíveis: Plano de saúde Unimed Fácil, com cobertura para cônjuges e filhos (com coparticipação); Plano de odontológico que contempla cônjuges e filhos; Vale alimentação; Refeições em nossos restaurantes parceiros; Auxílio creche conforme elegibilidade; Seguro de vida; Vale transporte; Mimo aniversário; Asfunimed - Associação dos colaboradores oferece vôlei e aula funcional, além de parcerias com instituições de ensino e salões de beleza; Estacionamento para o colaborador; Se você atende aos pré-requisitos da vaga, não hesite em se candidatar e esteja atento às seguintes orientações: Durante o processo de seleção, toda a comunicação será realizada por e-mail ou telefone. Certifique-se de manter seus dados atualizados e verifique regularmente sua caixa de entrada, incluindo a pasta de spam. Em caso de feedback negativo, mantenha-se motivado e atento a outras oportunidades que possam surgir. 🌟 Junte-se à equipe Unimed Cuiabá e faça parte do desafio de transformar a saúde suplementar em MT! 🌟 Buscamos profissionais comprometidos para enfrentar o maior desafio de uma operadora de saúde: proporcionar o melhor atendimento possível aos nossos beneficiários, em um cenário dinâmico e desafiador. Em um mundo onde as demandas por cuidados de saúde estão em constante crescimento, é essencial que nos destaquemos na excelência do atendimento, na eficiência operacional e na inovação contínua. A Unimed Cuiabá cuida de forma integral de seus clientes para que eles possam aproveitar a vida. Nossos serviços e atendimentos são pautados pela segurança, humanização e promoção de qualidade de vida. Como parte da nossa equipe, você terá a oportunidade de viver o jeito de cuidar Unimed, colaborando para encontrar soluções criativas e eficazes, e contribuindo para o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida da nossa comunidade. Se você é apaixonado por saúde e busca fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Confira as vagas disponíveis e junte-se a nós!
